opening: I was referred because my blood calcium is low.
The face spasms, muscle spasms and leg cramps started when I was about 10.
I've had spasms in my face.
I've had attacks where my muscles go into spasm (tetany).
I take vitamin D by mouth.
Since I was 4 I've had moderate hearing loss in both ears (sensorineural), and I wear hearing aids.
